decisions.proposedRule: Bind both retained rows to the source-proven non-property topic RecordingConfig/RecordingJobConfiguration in http://www.onvif.org/ver10/topics, with Source RecordingJobToken and Data ElementItem Configuration. Preserve original G role/condition and do not invent JobChanged.
decisions.reason: The missing authority was located in the immutable native service prose, not inferred from an operation name.
sourceFacts: onvif/specs:doc/RecordingControl.xml:1945-1954, clause 5.29.2, explicitly specifies this topic.
Source RecordingJobToken has tt:RecordingJobReference; Data Configuration is an ElementItem described with tt:RecordingJobConfiguration.
IsProperty is false and no Key is declared in that description.
The frozen catalog contains the named RecordingJobConfiguration type but no same-named global element.
Core 9.4.3's general ElementItem type-description rule therefore needs an explicit reviewed machine representation for this native type-bearing case; no global element QName is fabricated.

tests.expected: Both rows resolve exact source/topic/role data; unknown actual payload root is retained/reported rather than synthesized.
